notes: Founded 1898; a National Historic Landmark and the only continuously operating Chautauqua west of the Mississippi. 26 acres of Victorian cottages under the Flatirons, with the Dining Hall, Community House and 1898 Auditorium on site. The grounds are a public park, so this is a room block plus meeting space rather than a true buyout.
